payload.title: Adopt additive canonical meta-model v2 without rewriting history
payload.context: The first-generation foundation is useful but leaves several semantics implicit or ambiguous. Audit also discovered the current state document malformed while the historical bootstrap report claimed state validation passed.
payload.problem: Harden semantics without invalidating or falsifying historical task 0000000000001 evidence.

considered_options.option: replace all paths with a new layout
evolve the existing schema path additively, preserve historical records, repair only current state

payload.rationale: This keeps references stable, preserves audit evidence, and introduces canonical semantics for all new records.
consequences: foundation.schema.json advances to semantic version 2.0.0 while retaining the same canonical path
legacy identity-shaped source/actor values remain schema-compatible
new records SHOULD use explicit role bindings
verification becomes a first-class project.verification object
current state is repaired and normalized; historical report 0000000000001 is not edited
relationship values become constrained to a canonical vocabulary including legacy relationships already observed
payload.compatibility_impact: Backward-compatible for existing task/execution/evidence/report records; semantic normalization applies prospectively.
payload.migration_impact: No historical object migration required. Current mutable state is repaired. New records use v2 canonical forms.
